configs.rl:
# PREREG-LLM-GYM Stage 0 pilot: L_flow arm, era2019 bank, one seed.
# Identical to pilot_rl_2gpu.toml except two TRAINER THROUGHPUT knobs, changed 2026-10-06
# after the first A100 run measured 12-15 min per trainer step (MFU 11%, 9 GiB of 40 GiB used):
#   [trainer.model] seq_len = 16384   (was the shared 5120) -> packs ~3x more episode-turns per
#                                      trainer pass; orchestrator.seq_len stays 5120, so sample
#                                      truncation and the data the model sees are unchanged
#   fused_lm_head_token_chunk_size = 8192 (prime-rl default; 1024 was set for the 24 GB L4)
# Nothing about the learning problem changes: same episodes, batch, group, LR, LoRA, reward, prompt.
# Loss is a per-token mean over the global batch, so packing does not change the gradient.
#   uv run rl @ configs/pilot_rl_2gpu_a100.toml --run.name pilot_flow_s0

max_steps = 60
seq_len = 5120

[ckpt]
interval = 15

[model]
name = "Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B"

[trainer.model]
seq_len = 16384
fused_lm_head_token_chunk_size = 8192
ac_offloading = "None"
optim_cpu_offload = false

[trainer.model.ac]
freq = 1

[trainer.model.lora]
rank = 32
alpha = 64

[trainer.optim]
lr = 1e-5

[orchestrator]
batch_size = 64

[orchestrator.train]
group_size = 16

[orchestrator.train.sampling]
max_completion_tokens = 160
temperature = 1.0

[[orchestrator.train.source]]
name = "hedge-gym-flow"
env.taskset.id = "hedge-gym"
env.taskset.bank = "era2019_flow_train"
env.taskset.shuffle_seed = 1
env.agent.harness.id = "null"
env.agent.runtime.type = "subprocess"
env.agent.max_turns = 48

[deployment]
num_train_gpus = 1
num_infer_gpus = 1

[inference.vllm]
enable_lora = true
max_lora_rank = 32
max_model_len = 5120

configs.eval:
# Evaluate a model on the pilot's held-out FLOW worlds (400 tasks, greedy).
#   uv run eval @ configs/pilot_eval.toml -m <model-or-checkpoint>
model = "Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B"
group_size = 1

[select]
limit = 400

[client]
base_url = "http://localhost:8000/v1"

[sampling]
max_completion_tokens = 160
temperature = 0.0

[[source]]
name = "hedge-gym-heldout"
env.taskset.id = "hedge-gym"
